palette: deep peacock teal, ivory paper cream, copper seal bronze, berry wine red, sand gold, graphite ink
typography: charter-room headings on peacock plate rails, copper-stamped independence clauses and berry wax verdicts
composition: a charter atrium with four independence pillars, a classification triptych of wings, a foundation vitrine and a registry counter feeding an incubation lane
surface: ivory charter cards, peacock enamel plates, copper seals, sand-gold trims
motion: pillar plaques bolt upright one by one, classification wings unfold like folding screens, incubation contracts slide from the registry counter into the formed-person slot
transition: the atrium floor, plate rails and copper seal posts persist while pillars, wings and counters are re-dressed between scenes
